errors.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the ESPHome device. Make sure it is on the same network and its YAML includes an api: section.
errors.timeout: The device did not respond in time. Try again.
errors.resolve_error: Could not find the device on the network. Check that it is online, or use a static IP address.
errors.invalid_encryption_key: The encryption key is invalid. Check that it matches api → encryption → key in the device YAML.
errors.requires_encryption_key: This ESPHome device requires an encryption key. Repair it and enter the key from api → encryption → key in the device YAML.
errors.encryption_plaintext: This device is not using encryption. Remove the encryption key in Homey, or enable encryption on the device.
errors.encryption_hello: The encrypted connection was dropped immediately. Check that encryption is enabled on the device, and try again.
errors.handshake: Could not complete the encrypted handshake. Check the encryption key and that the device firmware is up to date.
errors.device_mismatch: The device at this address is not the one Homey paired. Check the IP address or DHCP reservation.
errors.mac_missing: The ESPHome device did not report a MAC address.
errors.no_supported_entities: This ESPHome node has no supported entities for Homey.
errors.device_not_prepared: Device was not prepared. Go back and reconnect.
errors.host_required: Host or IP address is required
